faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: About the Chrome extension and this companion site

q1.question: Is this website an online Telegram downloader?
q1.answer: No. This site introduces the product and links to the Chrome Web Store. Parsing and downloads run in your browser through the extension, not by pasting links into this domain.

q2.question: Do I need to log in on this website?
q2.answer: No. You may log in to Telegram only on the official Telegram Web or app when using the extension — never enter your Telegram password on random third-party forms.

q3.question: What can I download?
q3.answer: The extension supports video, images, GIFs, music, audiobooks, and files from Telegram in Chrome, subject to what you can access in your account and applicable rules.

q4.question: Does it handle large files?
q4.answer: Yes — stable downloads for 1GB+ files are supported when your network and Telegram allow.

q5.question: Can I use it on mobile?
q5.answer: This extension is for desktop Chrome. Use Telegram’s official apps on mobile; do not install desktop-only extensions on phones.

q6.question: Is it OK to save any video?
q6.answer: Only save content you are allowed to keep. The tool is for personal use and organization — respect copyright and Telegram’s terms.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: TGVideoDown ("we", "us", or "our") operates this website as a companion to the TGVideoDown Chrome extension on the Chrome Web Store. This policy describes browsing this site. The extension’s permissions and data practices are described in the store listing and in Chrome. By using the site, you agree to the practices described here.

collection.title: 2. Information We Collect
collection.item1: URLs of videos you request to download (only as needed to process downloads)
collection.item2: Optional user-provided data (e.g. email, username) if the Service includes feedback, support contacts, or registration features
collection.item3: Device/Technical Information (e.g. IP address, browser or app version, device type, OS) for service operation, debugging, abuse prevention
collection.item4: Usage Data (e.g. timestamps, download counts, error logs) to improve performance
collection.cookies: We use essential cookies to ensure website functionality. We do not use tracking cookies or advertising cookies.

use.title: 3. Use of Information
use.item1: Provide, maintain, and optimize the core video downloading functionality
use.item3: Monitor and improve user experience and technical performance
use.item4: Prevent abuse, fraud, or security threats
use.item5: Send optional service notifications (e.g., about service status, updates)

retention.title: 4. Data Retention and Storage
retention.item1: Video URLs processed are deleted immediately and not stored permanently
retention.item2: Log data is retained for 30 days for service improvement and security purposes
retention.item3: All data is stored on secure servers with encrypted transmission (HTTPS/TLS)

sharing.title: 5. Sharing & Disclosure
sharing.item2: Share identifying data with third parties except as necessary
sharing.item3: With service providers (analytics, hosting, CDN) under confidentiality terms
sharing.item4: If required by law (e.g. with law enforcement)
sharing.item5: In connection with any business transaction (e.g. merger, acquisition)

security.title: 6. Security
security.content: We implement the following security measures to protect your data:
security.note: Please note that no system is perfectly secure, but we are committed to protecting your data from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.

rights.title: 7. User Rights
rights.content: Depending on your location, you may have rights such as:
rights.item1: Access: see information we hold about you
rights.item2: Correction: update inaccurate or incomplete data

children.title: 8. Children's Privacy
children.content: Our Service is not directed to children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we discover that we have collected such information, we will delete it immediately.

changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically to stay informed of any changes.
